decision.rationale: REAL: falsifiable candidate registered as challenger council_the-aegis-mt5-demo-bot-is-running-the-in_de50a5 for the validation pipeline

proposals.text: Test a research-only 3-bar confirmation delay after each validated-state transition to suppress signals generated during state churn. Register an A/B walk-forward experiment against the current gate, measuring net expectancy after spread/slippage, signal precision, trade count, and maximum drawdown. Adopt it only if expectancy and precision both improve out-of-sample without increasing drawdown; otherwise reject it and retain the current champion.

question: The AEGIS MT5 DEMO bot is running the intelligent firehose with the validated-state gate. Given the current measured evidence, identify ONE concrete, falsifiable improvement candidate for the next research cycle. Do not modify code or the champion. Cite book corpus passages if relevant.
